versions.content: The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredDTC, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxDTCsPerMainFunction ) or the return ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’. In this case, the execution is postponed to the next J1939Dcm_MainFunctio n call.
